author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Announcement Trailer for Prison Pocket Patrol, a co-op prison guard simulation game developed by Chameleon 42 Games. Players will ensure the safe continuation of operations at the local prison yard. Stop fights, confiscate contraband, and adhere to the warden's strict orders. Prison Pocket Patrol is coming soon to PC (Steam).

The Vanguard’s Resolve Event Pass for War Robots: Frontiers is available now for PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam and MY.GAMES Launcher).

description: Here's a look at the Moha Gameplay Trailer for Pocket Bravery, a 2D action fighting game developed by Statera Studio. Don't miss Moha gameplay for Pocket Bravery, available now for PC (Steam), with a release on consoles coming soon.

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Story Overview Trailer for Stranger Than Heaven, an upcoming action-adventure beat 'em up game developed by Ryu Ga Gotoku Studio. Players will follow a man over the course of a fifty-year period as he traverses through five different eras and regions of his life. Take a deeper look at the game's narrative, filled with extreme violence and a yearning for home across multiple iterations of Japan. Stranger Than Heaven is coming soon to PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Xbox Cloud, and PC (Steam and Xbox on PC).
title: Stranger Than Heaven - Official Story Overview Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the Launch Trailer for Deep Rock Galactic: Rogue Core, a first-person action roguelite shooter developed by Ghost Ship Games. Players will face alien horrors from run to run across procedurally-generated caves as the dwarven Reclaimers. Make use of an array of weapons, attain powerful upgrades, and take on the deadly Corespawn. Deep Rock Galactic: Rogue Core is available now in Early Access for PC (Steam).
title: Deep Rock Galactic: Rogue Core - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the ‘Battle for Brooklyn’ Celebration Teaser Trailer for The Division 2, the hit third-person action co-op shooter developed by Massive Entertainment. Players can ring in the annual celebration of Battle for Brooklyn with a new Hunter and unlock new outfits through the Brooklyn‑inspired Event Pass. Attain looks inspired by LMB Boss, Rat Queen, Danvers, and the Cleaners Boss in the ‘Battle for Brooklyn’ Celebration from May 21 through June 4 in The Division 2 for PlayStation 4 (PS4), Xbox One, and PC.
title: The Division 2 - Official ‘Battle for Brooklyn’ Celebration Teaser Trailer

Mirth Island is coming soon to PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch, and PC (Steam).

description: Don't miss the Announcement Trailer for Flick, a first-person dark horror adventure exploration game developed by Inqdrop Studios. description: Your plane has exploded in midair, and as you plummet to the Earth, sans parachute, you are the only survivor – until you pancake into the ground, anyway. Wishlist it on Steam (and play the demo!) if you're interested: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4144510/Freefall_95/

description:
Check out the trailer for the Genesis Configuration in Clive Barker's Hellraiser Revival! The Genesis Configuration for the mysterious puzzle box will aid you in puzzle solving and exploration, allowing you to bend the nightmarish Labyrinth to your will. However, it will also aid you in combat, opening opportunities to unleash brutal attacks using telekinesis and pyrokinesis to hurl saw blades and ignite foes respectfully, or to summon the iconic hellchains to tear the enemy apart! 

Clive Barker's Hellraiser: Revival is coming soon to PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam)
